The two posts converge close together at the closed finish but remain distinct and mechanically connected to their respective overhead lever arms. A narrow opaque weight-stack housing is behind the back pad. A sturdy base supports the seat and back. No forearm pads. No exposed cable routing. No text, logos, arrows or labels.

Prioritize believable arm length, visible soft elbow bends, secure grips, and continuous machine connections. Leave margins around both feet and all hardware.
